title: Sneaking out of the hot spring

cues.text: You and the other three stand in the water beside a large rock. Beyond it, the girls are searching the bath.
Yukari and Fuuka come around the rock and find the four of you standing in the open. They stare, and Yukari turns away.
You lead the others through the water toward the rock.
You lead the others a few steps across the water, and the four of you hold still. Yukari and Fuuka walk up close, Fuuka peering your way.
You break from cover and run for the exit with Junpei and Ryoji, Akihiko behind you.
Mitsuru and Aigis turn round and see you.
All four of you dash through the water for the exit.
Mitsuru and Aigis turn round and see you.
You take Junpei's rubber duck and hurl it far across the bath. It drops into the water near Yukari and Fuuka with a splash.
Mitsuru and Aigis walk over toward the splash.
Aigis looks straight at the spot where you are hiding, and the four of you flinch.
Aigis looks straight at the spot where you are hiding, and the four of you flinch.
You lead the way, and the four of you creep toward the exit.
